summary: Google DeepMind announces two Gemini model updates live in the Gemini app: 3.6 Flash reduces token usage on complex coding tasks by up to 65%, and 3.5 Flash-Lite serves at up to 350 output tokens per second.

mechanisms.reason: The post states a specific reduction in tokens needed per coding task, which lowers the compute work required per unit of output.
mechanisms.quote: 3.6 Flash cuts token usage by up to 65% on complex coding

practices.reason: Two shipped model variants now offer stated reductions in per-task token cost and higher output throughput, both live for production use today.
practices.quote:
3.6 Flash cuts token usage by up to 65% on complex coding
+ 3.5 Flash-Lite reaches speeds of 350 output tokens/sec
